period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read directly from the bank's own Q3-2015 unaudited financial statements. Unlike other years, this filing is a single-page condensed 'newspaper advertisement' style disclosure with Consolidated Balance Sheet, Solo Balance Sheet and Solo Profit and Loss Account printed as three side-by-side panels (plus Consolidated P&L, Cash Flow Statement and Statement of Changes in Equity below) rather than National Bank's usual multi-page full financial statements format -- read directly from the page image at full resolution (no OCR). Comparative column (31 Dec 2014) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2014 total_assets (256537.46m) and equity (26963.95m) exactly. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2015 (first of four P&L columns: [Jan-Sep 2015] [Jan-Sep 2014] [Jul-Sep 2015 discrete] [Jul-Sep 2014 discrete]). Every subtotal in the identity chain was cross-checked and matches exactly: Total Operating Income = NII + Investment Income + Commission + Other Income (8824.53m); Profit Before Provision = Total Op Income - Total Op Expenses (5347.35m); Profit Before Tax = PBP - Total Provision (3218.24m); PAT = PBT - Tax (1518.24m). No NAV-per-share line is printed in this filing; nav_per_share is calculated.
